info.prompt: Synthwave confession booth with stained glass windows filtering neon cyan light across a bone-and-circuit game board, where translucent dice emit low-frequency hums. The HUD's skeletal gold brackets tremble as a gravity flip initiates—tiles slide UP with a 400ms settle—while a player's hidden die burns amber in its pocket slot, awaiting deployment. Racing indicators flare red/green/blue across pressure zones, their beat windows tightening as heat distortion warps the leader's field of play. All framed by oscillating hacker text that scrolls "SYSTEM OVERRIDE" in pulsating magenta terminal font.
